question_cn: 以下哪种描述符合「兵链」的定义？
question_en: Which description defines a pawn chain?

options.text_cn: 同一方两个兵并排（如e4和d4）
options.text_en: Two friendly pawns side by side, such as e4 and d4.

options.text_cn: 同一方的兵斜向相连、互相支撑，形如e5-d4-c3
options.text_en: Friendly pawns linked diagonally and supporting one another, such as e5-d4-c3.

options.text_cn: 两个兵纵向叠加（如d4和d5叠兵）
options.text_en: Two pawns stacked on the same file, such as d4 and d5.

options.text_cn: 任意相邻的两个兵，无论方向
options.text_en: Any two adjacent pawns, regardless of direction.

explanation_cn: 兵链是同一方的兵沿斜线相连、每个兵都由后面一个兵支撑，形如e5-d4-c3的锯齿斜线。并列兵（d4-e4）和叠兵（d4-d5）都不是兵链。兵链的关键是：每个兵都有斜后方的兵保护，整体结构坚固。
explanation_en: A pawn chain is a diagonal formation of friendly pawns, each supported by the pawn behind it, such as e5-d4-c3. Side-by-side pawns (d4-e4) and doubled pawns (d4-d5) are not pawn chains. The key feature is that each pawn is protected by a pawn diagonally behind it.
